sloka: हंस क्रौन्च प्लव आकीर्णम् सारसैः संप्रणादितम् ।वैदूर्य प्रस्तरम् स्निग्धम् सांद्रम् सागर तेजसा ॥३-३५-१८॥
transliteration: haṁsa kraunca plava ākīrṇam sārasaiḥ saṁpraṇāditam ।vaidūrya prastaram snigdham sāṁdram sāgara tejasā ॥3-35-18॥

translations.english: (It was ) full of small floats, flocks of swans, kraunchas, sarasas cackling in the ponds, with great joy. It had stretches of vaidurya stones on the shore and shone with the radiance of the sea
